text:
Ravi: Quick alert - a mid-month pricing experiment credit from vendor CloudMesh got applied and then reversed. Vendor invoice arrived late. We need to decide deferral vs accrual for 2024-11 month close. Credit amount $33,750.

Sasha: Are these credits applied as customer-facing discounts or reimbursed promotions?

Ravi: They're vendor-funded promos (CloudMesh). Applied on 2024-11-15, reversal executed by billing on 2024-11-18, vendor invoice dated 2024-11-21. We already recognized revenue on 6 invoices. Breakdown:
```
acct-101: $14,000 - annual committed
acct-202: $9,500 - usage overage
acct-303: $10,250 - annual committed
TOTAL: $33,750
```

Tricia: From revrec perspective: usage/overage credits should be reversed immediately (reduce recognized revenue). Committed subscription adjustments should be treated as deferrals and amortized over remaining term if they were billed as prepaid. How many invoices were billed/recognized?

Ravi: Six invoices total; 4 committed prepay, 2 usage-billed. For the prepaid ones, two are mid-term (6 months left), two are new annuals (11 months left).

Eli: Proposed journal entries for close (draft):
```
Dr Revenue Deferral (GL2100) 33,750
  Cr Vendor Accrual (GL2205) 33,750

For immediate usage reversals (2 invoices):
Dr Revenue (GL4000) 9,500
  Cr Revenue Deferral (GL2100) 9,500
```

Sasha: OK but note policy requires vendor accruals only if vendor confirmation exists or payment is expected within 60 days. Do we have vendor PO/confirmation? Also any amount >$20k needs FP&A notification.

Ravi: Vendor PO: CM-9921. Vendor email confirms reimbursement; ETA payment 2024-12-05. I'll attach the vendor note to the JE.

billing-bot: Reminder: Month close freeze in 6 days (2024-11-30 23:59 PST). Any adjustments must be routed by EOD 2024-11-29 for review.

Tricia: Please split the deferral 2 ways: amortize the committed credits over the remaining contract months (use weighted allocation for the two term lengths). For documentation include per-account amort schedule, original invoice IDs, and mapping to the vendor invoice. I'll need this before routing to Finance Lead.

Eli: I'll prepare the JE and amort tables. Tag memo: "CloudMesh pricing-credit reversal" and route to finance-leads@redwood.com. Also include linking Confluence page and attach the vendor invoice scan.

Ravi: Thanks all. I'll upload the vendor email and the invoice to Confluence and post the link here once done. :thumbsup:
